title: Critical Point Values
description: Essential Criteria: Provide correct values for V_c, p_c, and T_c at the critical point.

title: Dimensionless Ratio
description: Essential Criteria: Correctly evaluate the dimensionless ratio pV/RT at the critical point.

title: Modified Isotherm Explanation
description: Important Criteria: Clearly explain the concept behind Maxwell's construction and the area equality.

title: Heat Capacity Derivation
description: Essential Criteria: Show that the heat capacity at constant volume is a function of temperature alone.

title: Isotherm Sketch
description: Important Criteria: Provide a clear sketch of the isotherms in the p-V plane, including the critical point.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Avoid mistakes in calculating critical point values or misinterpreting the isotherm behavior.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
